name: East Side Coastal Circle
description: Hanauma snorkel, coastal lookouts, Makapuu, then Kailua beach + Pali on the way home

stops.title: Hanauma Bay
stops.note: Earliest slot — needs the T-2 reservation win (2 days ahead, 7am HST)

stops.title: Halona Blowhole + Lanai Lookout
stops.note: Roadside pull-offs, no walking

stops.title: Sandy Beach (watch only)
stops.note: Watch the shorebreak — no swimming

stops.title: Makapuu Lighthouse trail
stops.note: Paved; parents can turn around partway

stops.title: Kailua town lunch
stops.note: Pick a spot in town

stops.title: Kailua + Lanikai Beach
stops.note: Afternoon swim — park at Kailua Beach Park

stops.title: Nuuanu Pali Lookout
stops.note: On the way home over the Pali

pacing_note: ~90 min total drive in short hops — the friendliest big day for mixed mobility. Needs the Hanauma T-2 reservation win; skip Mon/Tue (Hanauma closed).

name: North Shore Classic Loop
description: Dole, Haleiwa lunch, turtles, Waimea, Sharks Cove, and sunset at Sunset Beach

stops.title: Dole Plantation
stops.note: Depart 8am; keep this short — Dole Whip and go

stops.title: Haleiwa lunch + shave ice
stops.note: Haleiwa town — shave ice at Matsumoto after lunch

stops.title: Laniakea Turtle Beach
stops.note: Keep 10ft from the turtles

stops.title: Waimea Bay + Waimea Valley
stops.note: Pick one: summer-flat Bay swim, or the Valley waterfall walk (shuttle for parents)

stops.title: Sharks Cove snorkel
stops.note: Water shoes; skip if the group is fading

stops.title: Sunset Beach/Pipeline
stops.note: Golden-hour finish, then home

pacing_note: ~2.5h of driving — the longest driving day. Front-load the morning and keep Dole short. Never stack this back-to-back with the PCC/Laie day — interleave big-drive days with town days.

name: Pearl Harbor + Town History

stops.title: Pearl Harbor full site (Missouri/Bowfin/Aviation)

stops.title: Chinatown food crawl
stops.note: Lunch — graze the markets

stops.title: Iolani Palace
stops.note: Or Bishop Museum; palace closed Sun–Mon

stops.title: Tantalus/Puu Ualakaa lookout
stops.note: Sunset — gate closes ~7:45pm

pacing_note: ~60 min of driving and the lowest physical demand — a good recovery day between big-drive days.

stops.title: Nuuanu Pali Lookout
stops.note: Start ~9am; $7 non-resident parking

stops.title: Byodo-In Temple
stops.note: Quiet respect; bring cash for admission

stops.title: Hoomaluhia garden drive
stops.note: Free; no stopping on the entrance road

stops.title: Shrimp-truck lunch

stops.title: Kualoa Ranch

stops.title: Chinaman's Hat viewpoint

name: PCC / Laie Day
description: Coastal stops on the drive up, then the Polynesian Cultural Center through the evening show

stops.title: Chinaman's Hat viewpoint
stops.note: Leave ~10:30 — quick coastal stop

stops.title: Laie Point
stops.note: Sea-arch lookout before the gates open

stops.title: Polynesian Cultural Center
stops.note: Opens 12:30 — villages, luau, evening show ends ~9pm

pacing_note: NOT Sun/Wed — PCC is closed, so only Thu/Fri/Sat work this trip. Home ~10pm after the show; parents can skip the show and leave at 6. Big-drive day — never stack back-to-back with the North Shore loop.
